subject: history
title: Indus Valley Civilization
description: Major cities, features, and important sites of the Harappan civilization

content.overview: The Indus Valley Civilization (c. 2500-1900 BCE) was one of the world's oldest urban civilizations, known for its advanced city planning, drainage system, and trade.
keyPoints: Major Cities: Harappa, Mohenjo-Daro, Dholavira, Lothal, Kalibangan, Rakhigarhi, Banawali
Harappa: First discovered site (1921), located in Pakistan, granaries, coffin burials
Mohenjo-Daro: Great Bath, Great Granary, bronze statue of 'Dancing Girl', seal of Pashupati
Dholavira: Water management system, reservoir, signboard with Indus script, located in Gujarat
Lothal: Dockyard, rice cultivation, located in Gujarat, important trade center
Kalibangan: Ploughed field, fire altars, located in Rajasthan
Rakhigarhi: Largest site in India, located in Haryana
Features: Grid-based city planning, advanced drainage, standardized weights, bronze tools, no iron
Script: Undeciphered, pictographic, written from right to left
Decline: Around 1900 BCE, possibly due to climate change, river shifts, or Aryan invasion
City-River: Harappa — Ravi River
City-River: Mohenjo-Daro — Indus River
City-River: Ganweriwala — Ghaggar-Hakra River
City-River: Dholavira — Seasonal Rivers (Luni & Manhar)
City-River: Kalibangan — Ghaggar River
City-River: Rakhigarhi — Ghaggar-Hakra River
City-River: Lothal — Sabarmati River
City-River: Sutkagen-Dor — Near Arabian Sea (Ancient Indus Delta)
City-River: Chanhu-Daro — Indus River
City-River: Alamgirpur — Near Yamuna River

mnemonics.trick: H-M-D-L-K-R-B = Harappa, Mohenjo-Daro, Dholavira, Lothal, Kalibangan, Rakhigarhi, Banawali
mnemonics.explanation: Remember: Harappa, Mohenjo-Daro, Dholavira, Lothal, Kalibangan, Rakhigarhi, Banawali
Mohenjo-Daro: Great Bath, Great Granary, Pashupati Seal
Key pairs: Harappa on Ravi, Mohenjo-Daro on Indus, Lothal on Sabarmati, Kalibangan on Ghaggar, Dholavira on seasonal rivers Luni & Manhar, Alamgirpur near Yamuna

quiz.question: Which is the largest Indus Valley site in India?
quiz.explanation: Rakhigarhi in Haryana is the largest Indus Valley site in India

quiz.question: The Great Bath was found at which site?
quiz.explanation: The Great Bath was found at Mohenjo-Daro

quiz.question: Which site had a dockyard?
quiz.explanation: Lothal had a dockyard, indicating maritime trade

quiz.question: Harappa is located on the banks of which river?
quiz.explanation: Harappa is located on the banks of the Ravi River

quiz.question: Alamgirpur is located near which river?
quiz.explanation: Alamgirpur is the easternmost Harappan site, located near the Yamuna River

timeline.event: Harappa discovered by Daya Ram Sahni
